title: 迈向可持续人工智能：深度学习模型碳足迹的综合回顾与比较分析
summary: 本文系统回顾了绿色AI和深度学习优化技术，比较了碳测量工具，并通过CPU实验评估了六种深度学习模型在多标签分类任务中的碳排放。结果显示训练阶段是主要排放源，且模型复杂度增加并不总能带来相应的精度提升，强调了在模型选择中平衡性能与环境成本的重要性。
summary_en: This paper systematically reviews Green AI and DL optimization techniques, compares carbon measurement tools, and empirically evaluates six DL models on a CPU for multi-label classification. Results show training is the main emission source, and increased complexity doesn't always yield proportional accuracy gains, highlighting the need to balance performance and environmental cost.
